attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Create a FK Chain.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetParent: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- Mirror: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- AutoRotate: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- SegScaleCompensate: turn this ON/OFF to enable or disable segmentScaleCompensate on all joints (FK + bind). Default is ON.
- CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 1).
- CtrlColor: choose one option (for example: lightBlue, blue, white, purple).
- CtrlType: choose one option (for example: square, sphere, cube, octagon).
- Template parent examples: Spine_End_Jnt, Head_Jnt, L_Wrist_Jnt.

Tips:
- if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly.
